already_present.name: Tor Kartingowy Le Mans Wrocław (Stadion)
already_present.comment: Present. Existing name has typo 'Kartnigowy'; better website is https://wroclaw.lemans.pl/ (indoor, >1000 m, 40+ Sodi karts 6.5 hp; adults 16+ 59/65 zł per 10 min Mon-Thu/Fri-Sun; kids 135 cm-16 y 49/55 zł; registration 10 zł; balaclava 12 zł). A seasonal outdoor Le Mans track at ul. Czekoladowa, Bielany Wrocławskie (450 m) appears in older listings but is not on lemans.pl or wroclaw.lemans.pl - not added.
